svg.title: P1 FEM stencil for the 1D Poisson equation
svg.desc: A uniform mesh on the unit interval with boundary nodes fixed at zero. Row i of the stiffness operator couples node i to itself with weight 2/h and to its two immediate neighbors with weight -1/h, and equals the load h.
svg.text: P1 stencil: one row of the Poisson operator
edge weights -1/h and 2/h travel with the Graph as per-edge values — the operator is applied edge by edge, never assembled
